503.description: A dependency is down; the body is the health status, not the error format.
A dependency is down; the body is the health status, not the error format.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: true = only current assignments, false = only ended ones.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First month, inclusive. Default: 11 months before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last month, inclusive. Default: the current UTC month.

field.description: Dotted path of the invalid field, for example `items.0.name`.

error.description: HTTP reason phrase, for example `Not Found`.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time the error was produced.

path.description: Request path without the query string.

details.description: Per-field problems. Only present on validation errors.

migrations.description: Whether every migration shipped in this build is applied.

year.description: JSON number only; no @Type, so "2023" is rejected.

userId.description: Optional login account of this driver; null/omitted = not linked.

endedAt.description: null while the assignment is active.

cost.description: Decimal string, e.g. "89.90". JSON numbers are rejected.

liters.description: Decimal string, positive, up to 3 decimal places, e.g. "45.500".

totalCost.description: Decimal string, up to 2 decimal places, e.g. "80.00".
